output.summary: A low-growing annual native to most of Europe, Asia and North Africa, henbit dead-nettle has rounded leaves, with its stalkless upper leaves clasping the stems. Its pink-to-purple flowers appear very early, sometimes through winter in warmer regions. Young leaves and shoots, stems and flowers can be eaten raw or cooked.
